ns0:entry.ns0:title: Forward Deployed Engineer — Freshers welcome — Chennai
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Actionboard
Chennai

Forward Deployed Engineer
Chennai · Work from office
Full-time
0–1 years

Work directly with clients to understand their business, design the data, and build the apps, reports and dashboards they rely on every day.

About Actionboard

Actionboard is a software company in Chennai. We build finance software that helps businesses run their finance work with less manual effort, see clearly what is happening, and make better decisions. Our products cover reporting and analytics, process automation, AI features, and custom apps built on our own app platform.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers sit between our clients and our platform. You will learn how a client’s business actually runs, work out what they really need, design the data behind it, build the app on our platform and test it, then stay with them until it works in their day-to-day. You will also work alongside experienced developers, helping with smaller tasks, debugging and fixes.

What you’ll do

  • Talk to clients to understand the problem behind each request and how their business works, and turn it into a technical plan
  • Design the data: the entities, how they relate, and the right schema for each app
  • Build apps on our platform: data models, forms, workflows, reports, dashboards and business logic
  • Break big requirements into small parts, keeping data correct, apps fast, and code easy to change later
  • When something breaks, find the root cause, from the source data to the number on the screen, and fix it, with help when you need it
  • Test features and edge cases so problems are caught before the client sees them
  • Help senior developers with smaller tasks, investigations and fixes
  • Write down how each app works: its workflows, data model and changes
  • Bring what you learn from clients back to our product team

Who we’re looking for

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field
  • 0–1 year of experience. Freshers are welcome
  • The basics of programming, data structures and object-oriented programming
  • The basics of databases: SQL, tables, relationships and schema design
  • You break a problem into small steps and ask good questions before jumping in
  • You learn new tools on your own and take feedback well
  • You stay with a problem until it works, even when it isn’t your part
  • You explain technical ideas clearly to non-technical people, and work well in a team
  • You can work full-time from our office in Chennai

Good to have

  • Hands-on time with any programming language
  • Some knowledge of web apps and APIs
  • Used Git, a debugger or tests before
  • College projects, internships or personal projects you can tell us about

What we expect

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. We care about strong basics, curiosity, clear thinking and how quickly you learn. Over time, you should be able to reason through a technical problem, see how a design choice affects data and performance, and build apps on our platform yourself.

How you’ll grow

You will get hands-on experience in app development, database design, debugging and delivering software that clients use every day. As you grow, you will own bigger and more complex apps.

How hiring works

  • Apply through Hasjob — no resume needed
  • Every application is reviewed by our team, with help from AI
  • If you are shortlisted, we email you a call letter with the date, time and address
  • You then meet us in person at our Chennai office for a conversation and a hands-on working session

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Founding Data Engineer (BigQuery, Python, SQL)
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Trident Automobiles
Bangalore

Trident Automobiles is a multi-brand dealer group: Hyundai, Renault, JCB, BharatBenz.

We're hiring our first data engineer to build the group's data platform from zero. You design and own the whole foundation and report directly to leadership.

What you'll do

- Build pipelines from messy real sources: scheduled exports, APIs (Tally, RealBooks, Interakt, CRM), and RPA for systems with no API

- Stand up and own our BigQuery warehouse - Solve customer identity resolution across four brands

- Backfill and structure years of historical data

- Build Looker Studio dashboards for leadership

- Later: internal apps (Firebase) and AI tooling.

You're a fit if you

- Have 4+ years building data pipelines end-to-end, ideally in scrappy environments

- Are strong in SQL and Python - Have used a cloud warehouse (BigQuery, Redshift or Snowflake; BigQuery a plus)

- Are fine with dirty data and pragmatic workarounds

- Can explain technical work plainly to non-technical leadership (essential)

- Own things without hand-holding Nice to have: RPA (UiPath, Python automation), BI/dashboards, automotive/finance data, Firebase.

Compensation: Very competitive, based on experience.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Automic Admin
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Potentiam Ltd
Bangalore

Experience : 9+ years.

Location : Bangalore ( Hybrid).

We are seeking a talented senior Automic Consultant with proven experience of working directly with end customers. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in Automic (Automation Engine) and a strong track record of completing installations, upgrades, migrations, and conversions in diverse enterprise environments. This role requires a customer-focused problem solver ready to travel or work remotely for clients, ensuring smooth transitions and optimal automation outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute Automic product installations, upgrades, migrations, and conversions for enterprise clients.
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for end customers during project delivery, ensuring their needs are addressed throughout the engagement.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues related to Automic deployments.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for deployment activities, configurations, and post-project support.
  • Collaborate with client IT teams to plan and coordinate project milestones and deliverables.

Provide knowledge transfer, training, and guidance to client personnel as needed.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Automic (Automation Engine), including installation, configuration, and administration.
  • Demonstrated background in customer-facing roles, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Deep understanding of IT automation concepts, batch job scheduling, and enterprise IT environments.
  • Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python) experience.
  • Experience conducting end-to-end migrations/upgrades of automation platforms with minimal downtime.
  • Experience with databases like Oracle, SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with UNIX/Linux and/or Windows server administration.

Nice to have Skills:

  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and change management.
  • Certifications in Automic, DevOps, or related IT automation platforms.
  • Experience with Broadcom AAI (Automation Analytics and Intelligence), formerly known as Automic Automation Intelligence.
  • Experience with Automic Database schema.
  • Experience in developing customized solutions to address specific customer needs for Automic.

About Potentiam

Potentiam is a global provider of highly qualified professionals to European SMEs from our offices in Romania, South Africa and India. Potentiam works with clients in finance, energy, leisure, marketing, business services and technology industries, providing technical, professional multi- lingual highly motivated staff, most of whom have had experience of working for international companies. Staff cover a wide range of roles from accounting, marketing, data management, HR, sales/account management, engineering, technology, and operations. Potentiam manages our staff’s career development and personal development training, all infrastructure, HR and payroll with our clients directly managing day-to-day staff responsibilities and role training and development.

Data Privacy Notice

The personal information you provide during the application and recruitment process will be used solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with our data protection policies.

All data shared with third parties complies with applicable confidentiality and retention requirements.
